008package paint.shared.objects;
009
010import paint.shared.config.GenerateSquaresConfig;
011
012import java.nio.file.Path;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * Represents a PAINT project that contains experiments, configuration objects,
018 * and references to relevant directories.
019 *
020 * <p>This class manages metadata and provides accessor methods for project-level
021 * configuration and experiment data.</p>
022 */
023public class Project {
024
025    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
026    // ATTRIBUTES
027    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
028
029    private       Path                   projectRootPath;
030    private       Path                   imagesRootPath;
031    private       String                 projectName;
032    private       GenerateSquaresConfig  generateSquaresConfig;
033    private       List<String>           experimentNames;
034    private final List<Experiment>       experiments;
035
036    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
037    // CONSTRUCTORS
038    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
039
040    /**
041     * Constructs a fully-specified {@code Project} instance.
042     *
043     * @param projectRootPath       the root directory of the project
044     * @param imagesRootPath        the images directory path
045     * @param experimentNames       list of experiment names
046     * @param generateSquaresConfig GenerateSquares configuration instance
047     * @param experiments           list of experiment objects
048     */
049    public Project(Path                  projectRootPath,
050                   Path                  imagesRootPath,
051                   List<String>          experimentNames,
052                   GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig,
053                   List<Experiment>      experiments) {
054        this.projectRootPath       = projectRootPath;
055        this.imagesRootPath        = imagesRootPath;
056        this.projectName           = projectRootPath != null ? projectRootPath.getFileName().toString() : "(none)";
057        this.experimentNames       = experimentNames != null ? experimentNames : new ArrayList<>();
058        this.generateSquaresConfig = generateSquaresConfig;
059        this.experiments           = experiments != null ? experiments : new ArrayList<>();
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Constructs an empty {@code Project} instance.
064     */
065    public Project() {
066        this.experimentNames = new ArrayList<>();
067        this.experiments     = new ArrayList<>();
068    }
069
070
071    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
072    // ACCESSORS AND MUTATORS
073    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
074
075    /**
076     * Sets the root path for the project and updates the project name.
077     *
078     * @param projectRootPath the new root directory path
079     */
080    public void setProjectRootPath(Path projectRootPath) {
081        this.projectRootPath = projectRootPath;
082        if (projectRootPath != null) {
083            this.projectName = projectRootPath.getFileName().toString();
084        }
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * @return the root directory path of the project.
089     */
090    public Path getProjectRootPath() {
091        return projectRootPath;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * @return the directory path where experiment images are stored.
096     */
097    public Path getImagesRootPath() {
098        return imagesRootPath;
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * @return the current configuration for the Generate Squares workflow.
103     */
104    public GenerateSquaresConfig getGenerateSquaresConfig() {
105        return generateSquaresConfig;
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * @param generateSquaresConfig the configuration to set.
110     */
111    public void setGenerateSquaresConfig(GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig) {
112        this.generateSquaresConfig = generateSquaresConfig;
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * @return the list of names of experiments in this project.
117     */
118    public List<String> getExperimentNames() {
119        return experimentNames;
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * @param experimentNames the list of experiment names to set.
124     */
125    public void setExperimentNames(List<String> experimentNames) {
126        this.experimentNames = experimentNames;
127    }
128
129
130    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
131    // STRING REPRESENTATION
132    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
133
134    /**
135     * Returns a detailed formatted string representation of the project,
136     * including its experiments and recordings.
137     *
138     * @return formatted project summary string
139     */
140    @Override
141    public String toString() {
142        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
143        sb.append("\n\n");
144        sb.append("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
145        sb.append("Project: ").append(projectName).append("\n");
146        sb.append("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n");
147
148        if (experiments == null || experiments.isEmpty()) {
149            sb.append("No experiments.\n");
150            return sb.toString();
151        }
152
153        sb.append(String.format("%nProject %s contains %d experiments%n", projectName, experiments.size()));
154        for (Experiment experiment : experiments) {
155            sb.append(String.format("\t%s%n", experiment.getExperimentName()));
156        }
157
158        for (Experiment experiment : experiments) {
159            sb.append("\n").append(experiment);
160            List<Recording> recordings = experiment.getRecordings();
161            for (Recording rec : recordings) {
162                sb.append("\n").append(rec);
163            }
164        }
165
166        return sb.toString();
167    }
168}
